text:
maia: :wave: Quick heads-up — we're changing the canary split policy starting next deploy window (Mon 06:00 UTC). Primary change: 10% -> 20% initial canary for model-serving routes that pass smoke checks. This is to shorten time-to-detection for perf regressions.

raj: Why the jump to 20%? worried about blast radius for customer-facing endpoints.

maia: good question. We audited recent regressions and most were missed in the 10% window. 20% reduces time-to-detect by ~40% on typical traffic shapes. We'll limit to routes with stable fallback policies and autoscaling enabled.

toni: operational checklist: can we require automatic rollback on error-rate > 0.5% for 5m? otherwise we'll have manual triage delays.

maia: yes — enforce rollback policy for these canaries. New rollout config snippet below (will be in the docs page shortly):

```
rollout:
  initial_canary: 0.2
  monitor:
    error_rate_threshold: 0.005
    evaluation_window: 300
  autoscale_required: true
  fallback_model: compatible-1.3
```

andrew: For SLAs: does this affect latency SLOs? increasing canary maybe surface perf regressions earlier but also could change tail latencies. Do we have a plan to route heavy-tail traffic to dedicated pools during the window?

maia: we will route production-critical routes to dedicated pools if their latency deviation > 15% during the canary. That routing is automatic when 'dedicated_fallback: true' is set on the route. We'll publish the list of affected routes in the release notes.

lina: oncall note — quiet window shift: to reduce noisy midweek rollouts, weekend quiet window moves from Sat 18:00->Mon 06:00 UTC for the next two cycles. emergency rollouts still allowed with ENG-LEAD + SRE approval.

raj: ack. how do we request an exception?

maia: open a ticket in #release-exceptions and tag @toni + @lina. include risk assessment and rollback plan.

deploy-bot: :bell: Scheduled deploy: canary-rollout/v2024.11 -> starts Mon 06:00 UTC; owners: maia, toni. Links: https://console.redwood.example/releases/2024.11

andrew: will run a quick perf sweep on dedicated pools pre-rollout. ping me if you want me to hold the rollout.

maia: thanks — appreciate that. final ask: if you own a route that will be in the 20% canary and you need exclusion, DM me by EOD today. :thumbsup:
